items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I say, “Driver let’s go home,” he say, “Yeah but the doctor.” ... We made a drum clinic for the doctor

ctx.x: They closed the bridge and I said, “I smell something funny.” He say, “Yeah.” Elvin was very quiet. I say, “Driver let’s go home,” he say, “Yeah but the doctor.” I say, “Don’t worry about doctor.” We made a drum clinic for the doctor, for days later.
Yeah it was Barry’s, over at Barry’s.
